purpose: Select one economically interpretable Campaign021 mechanism without opening a minute partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

selected_concept.economic_question: Does a stock respond more strongly to the immediately preceding broad-market minute move than the broad market responds to the stock's immediately preceding move, revealing delayed market-information incorporation that remains relevant from the next open through the third close?
selected_concept.economic_hypothesis: A positive stock-lag-minus-stock-lead dependence asymmetry indicates gradual absorption of common information rather than contemporaneous exposure or an own-stock return pattern. Greater delayed incorporation may persist over the next three sessions.
selected_concept.fixed_temporal_question: Compare exactly one-minute stock-lag and stock-lead dependence over all 236 adjacent return pairs wholly inside the two trading halves; never include the lunch transition or select a subwindow.
known_design_risks: lag definition, lead definition, lunch handling, equal weighting, leave-one-out construction, correlation estimator, peer threshold, degeneracy handling, endpoint tolerance, and direction are researcher degrees of freedom unless frozen before values
the candidate may be statistically redundant with contemporaneous market idiosyncrasy or late market-neutral residual drift even though it asks a lead-lag timing question
correlation asymmetry measures delayed common-information incorporation, not the sign of a single market move, so predictive direction must be frozen and tested rather than interpreted as guaranteed
using beta residuals, a late window, multiple lags, own-return autocorrelation, market net return, volume, amount, or a terminal factor would change the mechanism

rejected_concepts.reason: Return-variance entropy already terminally tests diffuse price discovery versus a few jumps; bipower, tail, or concentration substitutions would be a prohibited variant.
Volatility resolution, amount center of mass, late participation, and range time-allocation variants are terminal.
Changing Campaign020's disclosure clock, lag, decay, or threshold would be a prohibited repair of a terminal factor.
Combining or transforming Campaign001-Campaign020 terminal definitions is prohibited.
